title: Kelvo worker on Oracle E2.1.Micro: final d144a43 runtime with reviewed 9cad904 observer
scope: Worker-only accounting. Azure gateway, three NATS brokers, ClickHouse source, and all SSH tunnel processes are excluded. Does not certify later runtime changes or whole-cluster micro-VM fit.

observer.scope: Reviewed observer9cad904 is separate from the frozen final runtime source. Post-run input hashing follows the final shutdown sample; its time and allocations are excluded from active/shutdown counters. Startup input hashing remains inside whole-cgroup counters. Earlier observer profiles cannot be pooled with this campaign.

host.machine_scope: Oracle VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro: fractional CPU allocation; visible logical CPUs are not dedicated cores

conditions.transport: separate pinned-key SSH control, source and result connections
conditions.cache_state: warm and uncontrolled; independent reference preparation precedes profiles
conditions.competing_work: Coordinated Azure build/test launches were held during paired measurements. Read-only staging/hash I/O could occur; this does not establish an otherwise idle host. Oracle fractional CPU allocation, burst capacity and host steal vary.
conditions.metrics_interpretation: Five paired observations do not establish causal memory savings or a speedup.

orchestration_controls.scope: Injected cleanup transport and local-write failures only; no database/runtime/profile execution.

resources.sampling_scope: RSS: observed node and worker processes across delegated descendants. Cgroup: node, disposable children and Python observer; excludes source, gateway, NATS and SSH. Shared RSS pages can be counted twice; sampling can miss short peaks.

client.timing_scope: Submission through complete Arrow response at the Azure client; SQL, dispatch, verified TLS and Oracle-Azure SSH transport included. Value decoding is outside timing. Source/gateway/NATS/SSH resources excluded from separate Oracle node cgroup.

summary.scope: One executor, three serial queries then ten concurrent queued submissions per profile. Service cgroup includes observer; source, gateway, NATS and SSH excluded. Sample p95 is nearest rank, not a confidence bound.

cleanup.control_fixture_exit_scope: Explicit controller systemctl stop reached the fixture SIGTERM handler, which exited143 after finally cleanup. Captured failure status is retained; only this exact stopped fixture may then be reset and verified unloaded.

earlier_attempts.scope: Retained separately and excluded from these five pairs. No failed profile in this final-runtime campaign was retried.

exact_fixture_unit_unloaded_after_histor.scope: Only the owned stopped fixture was reset after preserving its explicit SIGTERM exit143. No other failed unit was changed.
